model.tooltip: The model the LoRA weights patch.

reflora_name.tooltip: A RefLoRA container in models/loras/. An ordinary LoRA also works -- it simply has no references to load.

lora_strength.tooltip: LoRA weight strength on the model. 0 skips patching entirely.

refmod_retention.tooltip: Reference strength. 1.0 = fully preserved, 0.7 = partially preserved, 0.4 = attribute transfer, 0.15 = weak. 0 loads no references at all.

members.tooltip: Which references to load, numbered as the Inspect node shows them: 'all', 'none', or a list like '1' or '1,3-4'. Unselected members are never read off disk.

attach_to_model.tooltip: ON: the references ride the MODEL output, so nothing has to be wired into the conditioning -- one node, one wire. OFF (default): use the H3_REF_MODS output with an Apply node. Do not do both, or every reference is injected twice.

clip.tooltip: Optional. MiniMax H3 LoRAs are lora_unet_* only, so this is usually left unconnected.

components.tooltip: Filter references by modality before loading them.

max_total_tokens.tooltip: Reference token budget; 0 disables it. References are not free -- a full-resolution identity reference can cost several thousand tokens in every DiT block.

show_info.tooltip: Print the container's contents to the console on load.

MiniMaxH3RefLoRALoader.name: MiniMaxH3RefLoRALoader
MiniMaxH3RefLoRALoader.description: Load a RefLoRA container: LoRA weights onto MODEL/CLIP and the embedded reference(s) out as H3_REF_MODS.

retention.tooltip: Master reference strength, multiplied with each row's own strength. 1.0 = fully preserved, 0.4 = attribute transfer.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE. Without it reference images/videos only condition the text encoder.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE. Without it reference audio only conditions the text encoder.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description: <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> reference conditioning for MiniMax H3. Use the same tags when prompting.
